CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Actual_Completion_Week__c) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Target_Week__c)), "", IF( VALUE( RIGHT(Actual_Completion_Week__c, LEN(Actual_Completion_Week__c) - 7) ) <= VALUE( RIGHT(TEXT(Target_Week__c), LEN(TEXT(Target_Week__c)) - 7) ), "On Time", "Delayed" ) )
CustomField.label: TAT Performance
